{{Top|leg}}
An '''advert-sphere''' was a floating device used for advertising. The sphere contained a spectra of [[krypton]], [[Argon/Legends|argon]] and [[Neon/Legends|neon]]. Advert-spheres were a common sight on the urban [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
